$comment: RFC 0197 §A.4 — v2 Class-3 corrections. Seeded with P3 only. The 2.8.2 removal of `workflowChainPacks.deferredParameters` and `.hostExpansionSeam` (P1) is deliberately NOT seeded: a committed bundle carried `deferredParameters` and then failed `capabilities-root-closed`, so the row would fail R3 — which is the point. P1 is recorded as the motivating defect in COMPATIBILITY.md §3a, not laundered into this register.

rows.compatibilityEntry: the v2 bare pack-manifest `signing` block and `FragmentNode.config`

priorShapeCensus.note: The prior shape is a manifest shape, not a discovery shape, so no bundle could carry it and the bundle leg is 0 by construction. The registry leg was measured at the correction: 0 of 190 published v2 pack.json documents validated against the schemas BEFORE the change and 185 of 190 after, so no published document carried the `{ publicKeyRef, signatureRef, method }` block the schemas described. `spec/v2/core/packs.md` §Signing, RFC 0177 §C.3 and migration row openwop.migration.C10.1 had already replaced it with `{ keyId, scheme }`; the schemas were the outlier against the prose, the Accepted RFC and the registry at once. `signing` stays OPTIONAL on a bare manifest, so no previously-valid unsigned document is invalidated. FragmentNode.config was closed by the v1→v2 seed against its own description, failing 73 of 81 published chain packs; reopening it narrows nothing.

The prior shape is any string; the corrected shape is the axis-1 `<major>.<minor>` grammar that spec/v2/core/versioning.md §1.5 and the v2-min-client-version scenario already required of an advertised value. Bundle leg: all 8 committed evidence/v2-host-bundles/*.json advertise minClientVersion, and every value conforms (seven "1.0", MyndHyve "0.1"), so 0 carry a value the pattern rejects. The one "0.1.0" in the corpus is a major-1 witness under evidence/rfc-witnesses/, not a v2 bundle. Registry leg: minClientVersion is a discovery field, not a manifest field; 0 of 156 pack.json documents on openwop-registry origin/main (c15d3d6) carry it. The schema added a pattern only, so no property, type or required entry moved and check-v2-surface-monotone sees no change.

rows.compatibilityEntry: an audit anomaly's shape, and `chainValid` as the aggregate verdict

priorShapeCensus.note: The prior shape is a verify result with `chainValid: true` beside a non-empty `anomalies`, or `chainValid: false` beside an empty one; the corrected shape is the root if/then/else RFC 0218 §C.4 adds, which the schema's `chainValid` and `anomalies` descriptions already required. Bundle leg: none of the 9 committed evidence/v2-host-bundles/*.json carries a `GET /audit/verify` body (no `chainValid` member anywhere). Registry leg: a verify result is not a manifest field; 0 of 157 pack.json documents on openwop-registry origin/main (4c5de1f) carry `chainValid`. The Anomaly members RFC 0218 §C adds are OPTIONAL additions that check-v2-surface-monotone reports as additive.

rows.compatibilityEntry: a refused inbound event dead-letters only its delivery

priorShapeCensus.note: The prior shape is behavioral: an event failing a `required` verification moved its subscription to `dead-lettered` with `state.changed.reason: signature-invalid` (v1 trigger-bridge.md §F.2 and the registration schema's `verification` description; v2 webhooks.md §Inbound triggers read the same way). Host census, read-only, 2026-09-30: openwop-app 5ee8cc064 returns `rejected` on a failed check and transitions a subscription only on `retry-exhausted`; MyndHyve 02e5d7fd2 performs no inbound verification (no `ingestion.verification[]`) and has no `dead-lettered` subscription state; no openwop-examples a6d61a6 reference host implements trigger ingestion. So no host implements the prior behavior and nothing conforming stops conforming. Bundle leg: 0 of 18 committed evidence/v2-host-bundles/*.json carry a trigger-bridge row (every trigger scenario is major-1 only); the six MyndHyve bundles advertise `triggerBridge.ingestion` without `verification[]`. Registry leg: a verification policy is a registration-request field, not a manifest field; 0 of 157 pack.json documents on openwop-registry origin/main (3b85bb4) carry one. Only a description changed, so check-v2-surface-monotone sees no change. Had a host implemented the prior rule, COMPATIBILITY.md §3's safety-fix exception would apply: the prior rule is an unauthenticated denial of service that no additive option closes.

rows.compatibilityEntry: the AI Envelope, deleted from v2 by steward decision

priorShapeCensus.note: Bundle leg: re-measured by check-v2-retirement through bundlesCarrying for every discovery-visible pointer; the typed count is that scan. The ext family a2uiSurface had no capabilities seat, so no bundle can carry it. Registry leg, openwop-registry origin/main f228326, read-only 2026-10-30: 13 of 656 published version manifests (registry/v1 and registry/v2) name a deleted surface. Eleven are vendor.myndhyve packs whose peerDependencies name aiEnvelope or host.aiEnvelope; their current versions (brand, kanban and web-research 2.0.0, registry#103) do not, and vendor.myndhyve.ai 1.0.1 and 1.0.2 are yanked, so no pack's newest non-yanked v2 version needs a deleted family (evidence/cross-repo-manifests.json registryCurrentPeerDependencyKeys). The other two are vendor.openwop.workflow-chain-sample 1.0.0 and 1.0.1, which carry envelopeType only inside opaque node config that no schema reads. Production census of the deleted run surfaces (RFC 0255 Motivation): 0 envelope_correlations rows, 0 fenced emissions in invocation_log, 4 stored ui.a2ui-surface events. Those 4 stay readable: run-event-payloads keeps the event type, and no persisted-data reader is removed.
